MARKER_OUTER_INCLUDE paragraph with **bold** and `codeph`.

- Outer include bullet one
- Outer include bullet two

```bash
echo "MARKER_OUTER_INCLUDE_CODE"
```

| Include Col A | Include Col B |
|---------------|---------------|
| MARKER_INCLUDE_CELL | b |
